title: What changed in this round

items.what: Every published Week 10 table re-read from the official pages and diffed cell by cell
items.before: 301 of 345 injury rows never re-checked (flag I-17)

items.what: The five-club depth pilot quantified against the 31-club collection already in the repo
items.before: 6 starters reported as ruled Out, presented as the count
items.after: 31 across 31 clubs; the pilot is now labelled a subset

items.what: The live-pipeline tree made reachable from the landing page and the nav
items.before: 15 pages with no inbound link; the reachability check skipped the tree
items.after: linked from index.html and the nav; the check now asserts every tree

items.what: The verify-site workflow made green again
items.before: tools/check_links.py failed with 111 errors on main
items.after: 0 errors; the two causes were a JS-template parse bug and a missing per-tree contract

items.what: A single review queue generated from four registers
items.before: four separate flag counts (6, 12, 17, 34) in four documents
items.after: one table, one count, one source link per row

items.what: A decision table with what is known, what is missing and what would close each gap
items.before: 18 questions listed, none showing the evidence that would settle it
items.after: 7 decision-critical questions with a recommended path and the decision each unblocks

items.what: A suggestions board ranked by what changes a number fastest
items.after: 10 options with dependency, reversibility and a first step, plus a recommended four-step path

unchanged: No published value was edited to make a check pass. All four tables verified as published.
